text:
Maria K: quick one — we tweaked the default connection timeout in the runtime config (from 200ms -> 300ms) to reduce transient errors. do we treat this as a patch or a minor bump?
Josh L: depends — is this a behavior change customers rely on? if it only reduces flakiness, id's say patch.
Zane: but it changes a default that could affect SaaS customers with tight latency budgets. that's more than a doc tweak. might warrant minor.
Maria K: no public API changed, but some internal dashboards showed higher tail latencies previously. i want to be conservative.
Emily: fwiw, our semver guideline has been: patch = bug fixes/backwards compatible; minor = new behavior/features. this straddles lines.
Rahul D: proposal: keep it patch, but add a clear release-note section called "runtime default changes" and call out potential perf impacts + suggested pin. also add an experiment flag for 2 weeks.
Josh L: that sounds pragmatic. also add an explicit pinning note: customers can pin to v1.4.1 if they need old defaults.
Deploy Bot: tag created: v1.4.2+build.202603 — pushed to staging. :rocket:
Zane: small nit — can we avoid buildmeta in the canonical tag? i'd prefer stable tags like v1.4.2 and rely on metadata in the release body. buildmeta makes cut/reverts messy.
Emily: the current release tooling appends +build by CI automatically. changing that is a bigger infra change. not for this release.
Maria K: action items: (1) leave version as patch v1.4.2, (2) add a release-note under "behavioral/runtime defaults", (3) open a follow-up RFC about tag metadata policy.
Rahul D: i'll add a note to the changelog and create the feature flag for 2 weeks.
Josh L: rollback plan: if we see regressions in prod after rollout window, revert tag and redeploy v1.4.1 pinned images + disable the new default flag.
Zane: +1 on the rollback plan. also add an e2e that pins to the old default to catch issues in staging.
Maria K: thanks all. scheduling the change window for Tue 03:00 UTC, small blast radius. will @oncall when we promote. :thumbsup:
Deploy Bot: deploy started: staging -> canary (v1.4.2) at 2019876600
Deploy Bot: canary healthy after 12m, promoting to prod at 2019876660
Deploy Bot: prod rollout complete at 2019876700
Emily: nice, keep an eye on 99th pct. if anything spikes we revert.
Rahul D: monitoring dashboards updated, alert if 99th > 3x baseline for 10m.
Maria K: closing thread — thanks everyone.
